stableFix.subject: fix(ui): stabilize rapid theme previews (#893)
stableFix.result: The pinned main and stable trees contain the same fixed ThemeSelectorDialog blob; render-time window synchronization and exact rapid-selection tests are retained in Rust.

nativeAdaptation.rendering: Ratatui reproduces all three frozen OpenTUI cell frames byte-for-byte, including clamped fixed-row overflow and transparent footer spaces over the border.
nativeAdaptation.controller: The prior immediate cycle action is replaced by a true modal with transient preview, committed identity, rollback, acceptance notice, and reopening on the commit.
nativeAdaptation.timing: A monotonic deadline implements the 200 millisecond pointer dwell and validates catalog, selection, geometry, and hover identity before applying it.
nativeAdaptation.input: The selector owns all keys, uses configured vertical review bindings, wraps arrow or Tab movement, scrolls its list window without previewing, and supports row, close-affordance, and backdrop mouse-up.
nativeAdaptation.catalog: The CLI retains configured and extension-provided custom themes in ReviewOptions so selector labels, identities, and palettes stay live.
